summary: Enhance your team's potential with our Coaching and Mentoring for Employee Development Training Course. Unlock skills and drive success in your organization.
lede: Coaching and mentoring for employee development helps leaders turn everyday management into a practical way to build confidence, capability, and accountability. This course shows you how to hold meaningful coaching conversations, ask effective questions, listen deeply, and give feedback that motivates progress. Through hands-on, interactive learning grounded in workplace challenges, you will explore how to build trust, establish mentoring relationships, and create development plans that connect personal growth with organizational goals. The result is a more learning-driven workplace where people can grow, perform, and thrive.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for guiding, developing, or supervising others. It is ideal for those who want to enhance their leadership skills and foster a culture of growth and development within their teams.
audience: Internal coaches and mentors in talent programs
modules: The Power of Coaching and Mentoring
Giving and Receiving Feedback for Growth
Embedding Coaching and Mentoring into Organizational Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have some experience in leadership or management roles. Familiarity with basic communication and feedback techniques is beneficial but not required.
